messages:
maria: planning to flip a runtime config: routing.bias_shift -> start 15% tonight. want a preflight + simulate in console before apply. cc @jared @kyle
jared: +1. product wants a single preflight card: cost delta, quota delta, top affected customers, risk band. make approval optional but auditable.
maria: backend preview endpoint: POST /api/configs/preflight_apply?simulate=true with payload. example payload shown in UI. curl: `curl -X POST /api/configs/preflight_apply?simulate=true -d '{\"key\":\"routing.bias_shift\",\"value\":0.15,\"stages\":[{\"pct\":15}]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
kyle: telemetry asks: emit metric config.preflight.risk_score and config.rollout.p95.delta; include sampled traces with header x-rw-preflight-id sample_rate=0.5 for WARN/FAIL. also add trace_id -> preflight_id mapping.
olivia: add dry_run that simulates routing decisions and emits metrics without changing weights. run a short synthetic for ~10m. UI should show a compact preflight report and an "Approve & Apply" button that requires a comment when top customers >3.
maria: rollout anneal plan: 15% -> 40% -> 75% -> 100% with 20m windows. auto-pause if canary p95 > baseline * 1.12 for >10m. if auto-paused, system should tag owners and set state paused_by_telemetry.
jared: add a tiny playbook in the card: how to pause, pin fallback, and rollback. rollback example: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{\"key\":\"routing.bias_shift\",\"value\":0.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
ops-bot: monitorbot: synthetic preflight queued (job sim-401). ETA ~6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand
kyle: also recommend adding a temporary SLO for canary: p95 target 210ms TTL 1h; if violated auto-pause and surface top traces in the preflight report.
olivia: UI tweak: show a small header example x-rw-canary-id and a lookup field so we can map request-id -> preflight_id -> config_version while triaging. product likes that.
maria: pushing preview now. will kick synthetic and post results here. if preflight shows red risk I'll abort. :rocket:
